name: sdlc-agent-sdk
description: SDLC agent pipeline SDK (Claude + GitHub Copilot) with cost estimation and human approval gate

scripts.build: npm run build -w @sdlc/core && npm run build -w @sdlc/claude && npm run build -w @sdlc/copilot && npm run generate
scripts.generate: node packages/claude/dist/cli.js generate --out packages/claude/template && node packages/copilot/dist/cli.js generate --out packages/copilot/template
